traditionalDress.men: Kurta-pajama, dhoti-kurta and sherwani are established traditional styles across different communities and occasions.
traditionalDress.women: Saree and salwar kameez are common; chikankari embroidery is strongly associated with Lucknow.

festivals.name: Holi
festivals.description: A major spring festival widely celebrated in Uttar Pradesh, with strong cultural associations in the Braj region.

festivals.name: Deepavali
festivals.description: Festival of lights observed across the state; Ayodhya is known for large public celebrations and ceremonial illumination.

festivals.name: Ram Navami
festivals.description: A religious festival associated with the birth of Rama and especially important in the cultural landscape of Ayodhya.

folklore: Uttar Pradesh contains several major regional storytelling traditions, including Ramayana and Krishna narratives in Awadhi and Braj cultural settings. Nautanki and Ramlila carry stories through music, dialogue and performance.
